response.justification: Strong, long-tenured senior engineer with broad full-stack, open-source and Linux experience, plus community teaching and a founded open-source geo-platform — all relevant to an open-source-focused consultancy. However, the role is an executive-level leadership position requiring formal team leadership, IT architecture ownership, requirements/UML modeling, security and compliance exposure, and German at C1 minimum for client advisory work. The resume shows an individual-contributor trajectory with no explicit people-management, project-management or architecture-lead responsibility, no UML/Python signal, and only basic German — a hard blocker for a client-facing consulting lead in the German market.
strengths: Deep, 15+ year full-stack track record across web, mobile, embedded and high-throughput backends
Genuine open-source credibility: founder of GISCollective, multiple D-language libraries, conference talks
Strong engineering practice culture (TDD, CI/CD, DevOps, workshops, mentoring/teaching)
concerns: German listed as 'Basic' vs. required C1 — likely disqualifying for client advisory
No formal leadership, team management, or technical project management experience
Little evidence of IT architecture design, UML modeling, requirements management, or IT security/compliance work
